send: i=0; while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != 1 ] && [ $i -lt 900 ]; do sleep 3; i=$((i+3)); done; echo BOOTDONE=$(getprop sys.boot_completed) uptime=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)

echo ===BOOTSOUND-BEGIN===; echo enforcing=$(getenforce); echo denials=$(su 0 dmesg | grep 'avc:  denied' | grep -E 'appdomain_tmpfs|scontext=u:r:audioserver' | grep -c .); su 0 dmesg | grep 'avc:  denied' | grep -E 'appdomain_tmpfs|scontext=u:r:audioserver' | sed -E 's/^\[[ 0-9.]*\] //'; echo track_failures=$(su 0 logcat -d -b main | grep -c 'could not create track'); su 0 logcat -d -b main | grep -E 'SoundPool|createTrack_l|play_l|keyguardDone:' | tail -n 20; echo ===BOOTSOUND-END===

echo ===LOCKSOUND-BEGIN===; t0=$(date +'%m-%d %H:%M:%S.000'); cmd lock_settings set-disabled false; echo lockscreen_sounds=$(settings get system lockscreen_sounds_enabled); input keyevent SLEEP; sleep 5; input keyevent WAKEUP; sleep 3; wm dismiss-keyguard; sleep 5; su 0 logcat -d -b main -T "$t0" | grep -E 'SoundPool|AudioTrack|createTrack|play_l|KeyguardViewMediator: (keyguardDone|handleShow|doKeyguard)' | tail -n 30; echo track_failures=$(su 0 logcat -d -b main -T "$t0" | grep -c 'could not create track'); echo denials=$(su 0 dmesg | grep 'avc:  denied' | grep -E 'appdomain_tmpfs|scontext=u:r:audioserver' | grep -c .); cmd lock_settings set-disabled true; echo ===LOCKSOUND-END===

echo ===AVC-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | grep 'avc:  denied' | sed -E 's/^\[[ 0-9.]*\] //; s/.*avc:  denied  (\{[^}]*\}).*scontext=u:r:([^:]*):[^ ]* tcontext=u:object_r:([^:]*):[^ ]* tclass=([^ ]*).*/\1 \2 \3 \4/' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn; echo ===AVC-END===
echo ===LOGCAT-BEGIN===; su 0 logcat -d -b all | gzip | base64; echo ===LOGCAT-END===
echo ===DMESG-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | gzip | base64; echo ===DMESG-END===
